title: Vintage 1980 Playboy Playmate Desk Calendar Easel Stand Original Red Envelope
condition_description: Never taken apart: monthly cards stacked behind the January card as issued. Easel stand clean with its fold-out back intact; light spotting on the back. Red envelope has a water stain across the top, tears along the top edge, and scuffs. See photos.
description:
Vintage 1980 Playboy Playmate desk calendar, (c) 1979 Playboy, in the original black and cream easel stand stamped "Playboy Playmate Calendar", with the original red gift mailing envelope ($2.50 cover price). Envelope measures about 6 x 8 in.

This calendar holds its 12 monthly Playmate cards as slide-in cards stacked behind the front card. January 1980 (Dorothy Mays) is on display; the stack has never been taken apart.

The easel stand is clean with its fold-out back intact, with light spotting on the back. The envelope has a water stain across the top, tears along the top edge, and scuffs - see photos.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
